court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: The wife seeks to challenge the decree for divorce obtained by her husband before the Courts below.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to challenge a decree for divorce to prove that the decree is null and void.
legal_principles.held: This Court therefore directed the learned counsel for the Railways to verify as to whether the said M.G.Meganathan, who was working with the Southern Railways had nominated any person to receive his terminal benefits.

legal_principles.principle: A nominee's nomination is effective until revoked or superseded.
legal_principles.held: The said M.G.Meganathan appears to have taken voluntary retirement from service on 01.03.2013. The document would further show that in the year 2013, Form 6 has been submitted by the said M.G.Meganathan, which is a statement showing the details of members of the family for the purpose of family pension.

outcome.final_order: The un-successful wife's appeal is allowed.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petitions under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
appealing against orders of Appellate Authority and Principal District Judge
using Section 28(1) (g) and Section 100 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
